timecoded_text_to_speech.text: Hi, this is Kim at Family Tank Camping and I'm going to show you how to set up the jet tent.
Now all there is to it is to stake out the four corners of the tent first.
It's opposite of the OZ tent instead of popping it up and then staking it.
You stake out the four corners first.
You just step inside the door away here and you reach down in the center and you pull up on the center hub.
And as you can see, extremely durable in the center hub,
no plastic pieces that can break.
So now this is just going to stand here like this, your corner stake out, you pop the hub up.
If you want to put the fly on, this is the time to do it.
Throw the fly over the top, let it hang over the four corners.
And then, just walk around and pull the leg joint.
Then you just anchor out your guy ropes that are kept in pockets all the way around and you're done.
You can find them at familytankcamping.com.

youtube_description:
The Jet Tent can easily be set up by one person, stake out the four corners and lift up the center hub and your done! It's that simple.
See more details on our website www.FamilyTentCamping.com
